about: A generated cohort whose outcome is drawn from a logistic model of its columns with a U-shaped sodium term and an age-by-albumin interaction (research/swarm/generators.py::readmission): the true risk of every row is known.

truths.name: the C-statistic of ranking every row by its true risk
truths.source: the generating model on the table's rows, by scikit-learn's roc_auc_score

truths.name: each model class's Brier regret against the true risk, E[(p̂ − p)²] of its population-best fit (the oracle's is 0; additive straight lines are the default path's class, so r0's planted nonlinearity is its regret)
truths.source: research/swarm/generators.py::readmission_regrets: an unpenalized logistic fit on 300,000 rows at seed 1, read on 200,000 rows at seed 2

truths.name: leakage
truths.value: none: no column is measured after the outcome or stands in for it
